description: This file contains Swagger API resource documentation classes for the SelfShareAccounts API in the Fineract project. It defines data schemas and response/request structures related to share accounts, including product options, charge options, currency details, and application requests/responses.

classes.name: SelfShareAccountsApiResourceSwagger
classes.description: Main container class holding nested static classes for API schemas related to self share accounts.

classes.name: GetShareAccountsClientIdResponse
classes.description: Response schema for retrieving share account details based on client ID, including product and charge options.

classes.name: GetShareAccountsProductOptions
classes.description: Represents options for share products, including identifiers, names, and share counts.

classes.name: GetShareAccountsChargeOptions
classes.description: Details for share account charges, including currency, time type, applies to, calculation, and payment mode.

classes.name: GetShareAccountsCurrency
classes.description: Currency details associated with charges, including code, name, decimal places, display symbols, and labels.

classes.name: GetShareAccountsChargeTimeType
classes.description: Type information for charge timing, such as ID, code, and description.

classes.name: GetShareAccountsChargeAppliesTo
classes.description: Specifies what the charge applies to, e.g., shares.

classes.name: GetShareAccountsChargeCalculationType
classes.description: Defines calculation type for charges, e.g., flat rate.

classes.name: GetShareAccountsChargePaymentMode
classes.description: Payment mode for charges, e.g., regular payments.
